'''Scarl''' was the name of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction facilities located in the [[Scarl system/Legends|Scarl system]], just [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] from [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. Scarl was located on the restricted [[Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane]].

==History==
After the failure of the [[Sarlacc Project]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] installed this secret [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] where began the construction of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].

It was from the still under construction ''Executor'' that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] dispatched his secret apprentice [[Galen Marek]] on a number of missions in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] became the most important Imperial project and the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] was towed to the largest [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] in order to accelerate its construction.

The Scarl shipyards were later reclaimed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Prior to the [[Orinda campaign]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' had been all but abandoned in the shipyards, used as a medical research facility.<ref name="TEGtW" />
